title: Prescribed burns continue across the state with smoke impacts possible
snippet: Autumn is a good time of year for prescribed burn projects to be accomplished across Colorado due to favorable weather and fuel conditions. Upcoming burn projects across the state can always be viewed on the CDPHE prescribed fire map . One large landscape burn that was conducted this past weekend was the Magic Feather burn in the Red Feather Lakes area of Larimer County. Information on this project and others can be found on the Arapaho and Roosevelt National Forest website and Facebook page…
